w: A cement-quarry wall northwest of Sucre holds the world's densest dinosaur trackway: mapping in 1998-2015 found 12,092 footprints across 465 trackways, tilted near-vertical over roughly 65,000 square metres of Cretaceous limestone -- theropods, ornithopods, ankylosaurs and sauropods, once walking a lake shore.
s: 12,092 dinosaur footprints on a quarry wall.
_facts: About 4.4 km northwest of Sucre, in the El Molino Formation
12,092 individual dinosaur tracks across 465 trackways, mapped 1998-2015
Near-vertical track-bearing surface of roughly 65,000 sq m
Sauropod trackways make up 26% of the total

w: Bolivia's premier Catholic cathedral took 153 years to complete, built between 1559 and 1712 on Sucre's main square, back when the city was still called La Plata. Formally the Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception, it remains the seat of the Roman Catholic Church in Bolivia.
s: 153 years in the building, Bolivia's premier cathedral.
_facts: Also called the Cathedral of the Immaculate Conception
Seat of the Roman Catholic Church in Bolivia
City was then known as La Plata

n: National Archive and Library of Bolivia
w: Established in 1836, this Sucre institution now holds 114,000 volumes of Bolivia's documentary memory -- founded not long after independence, when the young republic still called Sucre its capital and needed somewhere official to keep its paper trail.
